description: A read-only link to the brand report that anyone with it can open, without an account, until it expires or is revoked (report_link_revoke). The page shows the report as it is now; make a new link later for newer numbers.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

starts_on.description: Any day in the period (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the last full week or month

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: report_link_create
title: Share a brand report
